name: Adam Lawrence
bioAdditions: Seventh child of William Lawrence Jr. and Deborah Smith; member of the State Legislature and High Sheriff of Queens; died 1780, leaving Deborah (Mrs S. Van Wyck), Sarah (Mrs James Hewlett), Catharine (Mrs Platt), Dr. Daniel, Stephen, Joseph, Clark and George (S1).

sources.citation: Thomas Lawrence, Historical Genealogy of the Lawrence Family (1858) (archive.org full text), p. 27
